project_type: Python FastAPI app - NEXUS Autonomous AI Company Operating System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, asyncio_mode=auto, all tests in tests/ directory
test_command: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.pyenv/shims:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany && python3.12 -m pytest tests/ --tb=short -q
verification_instructions: Run pytest on all tests in tests/ directory. All tests must pass including new ones.
environment_constraints: Python 3.12 via pyenv at /opt/toolchains/.pyenv/shims/python3.12. No numpy/scipy allowed - stdlib only (math, statistics) for statistical operations.
contribution_requirements: No breaking changes to existing modules. New modules follow existing patterns: class-based, docstrings on all classes and public methods, type hints throughout. LLM modules accept Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]] and fall back to heuristics on failure.
key_patterns: LLM integration pattern: accept llm_callable: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]] in constructor, use AsyncMock in tests, fall back to heuristic method on any failure. Governance: all promotions require approval_id (ValueError if None). Tests: class-based TestXxx groupings, fixtures for UUIDs, pytest.mark.asyncio for async tests.
directory_structure: src/nexus/evolution/ - Evolution Engine module with analyzer, proposer, evaluator, sandbox, agent_evolution, skill_evolution, failure_alchemy, observer, promoter. tests/ - flat test directory with test_evolution.py covering all evolution classes.
